what: adaptive-traffic-signal-rl reproduced unchanged before two of its files were reused (fidelity rule 3). Its own benchmark was rerun from its shipped checkpoint on its own built-in simulator and compared with the tables it ships.
environment: Python 3.11.14 venv outside the repository with the project's requirements.txt (numpy 1.26.4, torch 2.2.2)
own_safety_tests: tests/test_phases_safety.py: 5 tests, all passed (the log shows five dots and no failure)
result: 36 runs (3 controllers x 4 demand levels x 3 seeds). Every output table is byte-identical to the shipped one.
published_headline: RL reduces average waiting time by 37.9 % against fixed-time (mean across scenarios), on the project's point-queue simulator
limits: This reproduces the project's own simulator result. It says nothing about SUMO or Dhaka. Of this project we reuse only src/atsc/control/emergency.py and src/atsc/envs/phases.py.
